description: This source file defines a Java interface for interacting with an external API related to loan products in the Fineract project. It includes a method to retrieve loan product details by ID, utilizing Retrofit annotations for HTTP GET requests.

classes.name: LoanProductsCustomApi
classes.description: An interface for Retrofit to define API endpoint for fetching loan product details by product ID.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductDetails
methods.description: Fetches the details of a loan product specified by productId, with an optional template parameter.
